promptZh: 从下面七个选项中为五个空格选出最恰当的句子。

explanation.summaryZh: 短文介绍间隔复习法：短时多次复习、充足睡眠和自我检测比长时间突击更有效。
explanation.ruleZh: 七选五要关注空格前后的指代和逻辑词：本篇依次由破除误区、具体计划、睡眠、自测到收尾建议推进。

evidence.quote: Many students think the secret to good grades is studying for hours without a break.

distractors.reasonZh: 只讲咖啡让人清醒，没有回应怎样安排复习，且与保护睡眠的建议冲突。
音乐背景与上下文的复习计划、睡眠和自测毫无衔接。

sharedOptions.text: Short, regular sessions actually help the brain remember far more.
The next day, a ten-minute review will be enough to refresh your memory.
Going to bed at a proper time is part of studying, not a waste of it.
This feels harder than reading the notes again, and you may remember less at first.
A wiser choice is to plan three short reviews across the week.
Drinking coffee late at night can keep you awake for hours.
Some students prefer to study with music playing in the background.

segments.text: Many students think the secret to good grades is studying for hours without a break.

Researchers call this the spacing effect, and it works for almost every subject.

Here is a simple plan. After class, spend fifteen minutes reviewing the main points. Then wait a day before you look at them again.

Each review can then be shorter than the one before, because the material feels more familiar.

Sleep matters as well.

While you rest, your brain quietly sorts and stores what you learned during the day.

Finally, test yourself instead of simply rereading. Close the book and write down everything you remember.
That little struggle is exactly what makes memory stronger. The next time homework piles up, do not reach for another energy drink.
Divide the work into small pieces, space them out, and protect your sleep.

gaps.label: 第1空
gaps.clue: 空后出现 the spacing effect
gaps.explanationZh: 空后说研究者称之为间隔效应，说明空前提出与长时间突击相反的观点，对应 o1。

gaps.label: 第2空
gaps.explanationZh: 前句说等一天再看笔记，后句说每次复习可以更短，o2 承接第二天的短时复习。

gaps.label: 第3空
gaps.explanationZh: 前句说睡眠同样重要，后句说大脑在你休息时整理信息，o3 补充按时睡觉也是学习的一部分。

gaps.label: 第4空
gaps.clue: 后句说这种挣扎让记忆更牢
gaps.explanationZh: 后句说这种小小的挣扎让记忆更牢固，o4 先承认自测更难、起初记得少，衔接自然。

gaps.label: 第5空
gaps.explanationZh: 结尾段否定熬夜喝能量饮料，o5 给出每周三次短复习的替代方案，与末句分配任务、保护睡眠呼应。
